definitions.measured_cell_benefit: Delta^cell = S(f_a; E) - S(f_0; E), the observed adapt-minus-frozen score difference for one measured cell
definitions.false_adapt_unconditional: FA_u^cell = (# measured cells with g=ADAPT and Delta^cell<=0)/(# measured cells) in the released empirical rows; this empirical fraction is not population risk
definitions.false_adapt_conditional: FA_c^cell = (# measured ADAPT cells with Delta^cell<=0)/(# measured ADAPT cells), when the denominator is nonzero; descriptive only
definitions.population_certificate_target: A population certificate requires the interval and action to concern the same declared scalar target B; measured-cell coverage alone does not establish population-risk coverage

quantile_provenance.current_policy_rule: Unclamped exact empirical rank k=ceil((n+1)(1-alpha)); an infeasible rank forces abstention rather than clamping.
